apps.description: Transcribers make spoken content such as meetings, interviews, or calls structured and searchable for AI.

TranscriberListTable.emptyDescription: No transcribers have been created yet.

TranscriberEditor.confirmDeleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete transcriber "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.

TranscriberEditorDiscardAllChanges.labelDiscardConfirm: Do you really want to discard all unsaved changes to this transcriber?

TranscriberEditorOverview.emptyDescription: Define the behavior and appearance of the transcriber.
TranscriberEditorOverview.descriptionDefinePrompt: A short prompt helps the transcriber understand and correctly write names, technical terms, and product names the way you expect them.
TranscriberEditorOverview.helpPromptDescription: With a prompt, the transcript needs less correction afterwards and you get a more consistent result for longer or topic-specific recordings.

TranscriberEditorPrompt.descriptionWhisperPrompt: The prompt is passed to the transcription model (Whisper) to help it understand domain-specific terms.

TranscriberEditorSettingsAppearance.description: Determine a color and an icon that best represents the transcriber.

TranscriberEditorSettingsDescription.description: Choose a suitable name for the transcriber. Additionally, a short description can also be saved.

TranscriberEditorSettingsModel.description: The transcription model the transcriber uses.

TranscriberEditorSettingsWorkspace.description: Select the workspace in which the transcriber should be created.

AudioRecorder.descriptionSaved: Recording saved. Transcription will start automatically.
AudioRecorder.errorUnsupported: Audio recording requires a supported browser and a secure connection (HTTPS or localhost).
AudioRecorder.errorPermission: Microphone access was denied. Allow microphone access in your browser and try again.
AudioRecorder.errorRecording: The microphone could not record audio. Check your device and try again.
AudioRecorder.errorEmpty: The recording contains no audio. Please record again.
AudioRecorder.errorUpload: The recording could not be saved. You can listen to it and retry the upload.
AudioRecorder.descriptionScreenAwake: The screen stays awake while recording.
AudioRecorder.descriptionScreenSleep: The screen cannot be kept awake. Keep this page open and prevent the screen from locking automatically.
AudioRecorder.descriptionCloseBlocked: Stop the recording and save or discard it before closing. Wait for any upload to finish.

TranscriberEditorSettingsRetries.description: When results are uncertain or highly repetitive, the transcriber can try recognizing an audio section again. More attempts may improve recognition and take longer.
TranscriberEditorSettingsRetries.descriptionFast: One attempt per audio section, without automatic retries.
TranscriberEditorSettingsRetries.descriptionBalanced: Up to 3 attempts per audio section.
TranscriberEditorSettingsRetries.descriptionThorough: Up to 6 attempts per audio section.
TranscriberEditorSettingsRetries.errorLevel: Please select one of the three levels.

page.emptyDescription: No transcribers have been created yet.
page.helpSearchDescription: You can search for transcribers. The search includes, among other things, the name and description of the transcriber, as well as its model.
page.helpSortDescription: Transcribers can be sorted by name. They can be sorted into different groups. Transcribers can be displayed as cards or as a table.
